verdict.rationale: Ironclad is a contract-management SaaS with AI features, so whether customer data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, data-usage policy, or no-training commitment. The AI product pages (docs-12, docs-24) offer only marketing taglines, and the API, webhook and clickwrap docs are unrelated to the story.
